messages:
Lara: Quick design check: I opened a variant that tightens vertical spacing in the Rules list. Link: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/tightspace-rule-clarity
Lara: Goal: reduce scroll but keep controls discoverable. Is this 🙌 or 🤔? @Jon @Priya @Marco
Jon: Nice work. Concern: compressed rows make the drag affordance too close to the rule label. Keyboard focus order needs to be explicit.
Priya: Copy thought: when space is tight we should move auxiliary copy into a hover tooltip, not remove it. Tooltips + accessible descriptions via aria-describedby.
Marco: Preview behavior note: currently the preview panel highlights matching rules but the visual weight is low. With tighter spacing we should add a 2px left accent bar instead of full background to preserve hierarchy.
Jon: Also, we should avoid reducing hit targets under 44px on touch. If a row looks small, ensure the actionable area remains big. Maybe pad the invisible hit area.
Priya: Microcopy tweak: validation message currently: "Rule invalid" -> prefer "Rule won't match requests: add a condition". Actionable and explains why.
Lara: Good — also thinking about the inline validation state. Instead of a global toast, show a subtle pill on the row: "Needs condition" with a chevron to open details.
Marco: Pill is good. For equal-priority ordering, PMs are confused by default sort. We should display a tiny entropy icon + tooltip: "Same priority: manual order controls this" and expose a quick reorder handle.
Jon: Accessibility: drag handle should have role="button" aria-label="Reorder rule" and use aria-grabbed during drag. If we implement keyboard reordering, up/down with modifiers should be supported.
Priya: Empty-state copy for preview: "No results yet. Run a preview with a sample request to see which rules match." Add a dropdown of sample payloads.
Lara: design-bot: contrast scan?
design-bot: Automated check: 2 label tokens below AA in tightspace variant (ids: lbl-07, lbl-11). Recommend color shift from #6B6F76 -> #53565A.
Marco: Also a tiny animation suggestion: when reordering, animate the left accent bar instead of entire row to reduce layout shifts.
Jon: Debounce note: preview spinner lag on rapid toggles — debounce 200-300ms or cancel previous request. I'll follow up with eng-runtime.
Priya: I'll draft the pill copy and hover tooltip copy, plus the revised validation strings and push to the file.
Lara: Action items: Priya copy, Jon accessibility spec + debounce, Marco preview visuals + reorder affordance, I'll update Figma with clickable prototypes. Review in two days. :thumbsup:
Marco: I'll include a short repro for the spinner in the PR.
Jon: I'll add keyboard reorder keymap to the a11y doc.
Priya: Pushed copy suggestions to the Figma text layers.
Lara: Thanks team — nice progress!
